Lina (AE): Acme Capital LOI signed. POC Wed. They need reserved GPUs + burst plan, 99.9% SLA, p95 <200ms. Profile: sustained 300 rps chat, ~512 tokens avg incl history, spikes to 800 rps for 2-6m. They prefer 13B quant but may require 70B. Also sent sec questionnaire (CMK, IPSec, EU residency).

Chris (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: 300 rps sustained = concurrent? 512 includes KV history? Which exact model variant for the POC?

Lina (AE): Yes sustained concurrent. 512 includes history. Default ask = 13B quantized for cost.

Devon (Infra): Ballpark: tuned 13B-quant on A100 => ~90-120 rps/GPU depending on KV hit and batching. Plan: reserve 4 GPUs baseline (safety), autoscale to 8 for bursts or provide guaranteed burst credits for +3-4 GPUs. Cold KV will blow p95.

Chris (SE): Recommended POC config: reserve 4 GPUs, min_replicas=3, autoscale max=8, prewarm KV 10m before windows, fallback to 13b-8bit-quant variant.

Chris (SE): Autoscale snippet to include in notes:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 8
  metric: pending_requests
  eval_window: 30s
  scale_up_threshold: 60
  scale_down_threshold: 12
  cooldown_seconds: 45
prewarm_kv: true
kv_warm_policy: prefixes=true, async=true
fallback_variant: model-13b-8bit-quant
```

Devon (Infra): Ops: schedule tiny continuous preheat during POC, use adaptive batching (max_batch_latency=10ms). I'll run microbench on prod-like hardware and post raw logs. Microbench cmd: `./microbench --model model-13b-8bit-quant --concurrency 256 --avg_tokens 512 --history-prefill --duration 600`. Quick local: 1xA100 ~95 rps warm, p95 180-240ms; expect ~120 rps after tuning.

Sam (Pricing): I'll prepare 3-option pricing: minimal (3x A100), recommended (4x reserved + burst credits), HA (6x reserved). CMK add-on modeled separately. Draft by EOD.

Clare (Legal/Sec): Questionnaire flags: SOC2, CMK, audit logs, EU data residency, IPSec/VPN. If CMK required during POC mark as enterprise-only or require work. Default log retention 90d; customer may request 365.

Lina (AE): Action items: Chris: sizing matrix + autoscale doc (EOD tomorrow). Devon: bench logs (tomorrow noon). Sam: pricing table (EOD). Clare: questionnaire draft (EOD). Ops: schedule POC run & preheat. Upload to deal folder when ready.
